scripts.build: pnpm run pages:generate && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.serve: pnpm run pages:generate && vite preview --config vite.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0

scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm dlx wrangler@latest pages deploy dist/public
